name: Modified DCF (DOCEtaxel + CISplatin + Fluorouracil) (metastatic anal SCC)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.histology: squamous cell carcinoma of the anus
biomarkers.note: The modified docetaxel/cisplatin/fluorouracil triplet is an intensive first-line option for metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma in very fit patients, offering high response rates at the cost of greater toxicity than a platinum doublet. No routine molecular biomarker gate for regimen selection; DPYD testing advised before fluoropyrimidine exposure. General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling to reduce hypersensitivity and fluid retention.

premedications.name: Cisplatin hydration + antiemetics
premedications.notes: Pre- and post-cisplatin IV hydration with magnesium/potassium repletion; highly emetogenic antiemetic prophylaxis on treatment days.

supportiveCare: Modified DCF given every 2 weeks (14-day cycle) for up to 8 cycles, the dose-attenuated schedule chosen to improve tolerability over classic 3-weekly DCF.
Prophylactic myeloid growth factor support is recommended given the febrile-neutropenia risk of the triplet.
Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing before starting (FDA boxed warning).
monitoring: CBC before each cycle and around nadir
renal function, magnesium, and potassium before each cisplatin dose
peripheral neuropathy and hearing assessment (cumulative cisplatin)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3-4 neutropenia, febrile neutropenia, or renal impairment
doseModificationRules.text: Delay and dose-reduce the triplet for cytopenias or declining renal function; add or intensify growth-factor support. Clinical review required.
Reduce dose or avoid fluorouracil in DPYD-deficient patients per FDA boxed warning; clinical review required.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: DOCEtaxel 40 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 14-day cycle (modified DCF schedule). Requires corticosteroid premedication. ISMP tall-man: DOCEtaxel (distinguish from PACLitaxel). General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 40 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 14-day cycle (modified DCF schedule), with vigorous hydration and electrolyte repletion. ISMP tall-man: CISplatin (distinguish from CARBOplatin). General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: Fluorouracil 1200 mg/m2/day by continuous IV infusion on days 1 and 2 (total 2400 mg/m2 over 46 hours) of a 14-day cycle, the modified DCF schedule. DPYD testing advised before starting (FDA boxed warning). General reference: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita.
